definitions.explanation: A feeling of worry or concern about a potential negative outcome. More formal than {心配|しんぱい} and often used in written or official contexts.

examples.japanese: {環境破壊|かんきょうはかい}が{危惧|きぐ}されている。
examples.english: Environmental destruction is a cause for concern.

examples.japanese: {専門家|せんもんか}は{人口減少|じんこうげんしょう}に{危惧|きぐ}の{念|ねん}を{示|しめ}した。
examples.english: The experts expressed concern about population decline.

examples.japanese: この{動物|どうぶつ}は{絶滅|ぜつめつ}{危惧|きぐ}{種|しゅ}に{指定|してい}されている。
examples.english: This animal is designated as an endangered species.

notes:
Also functions as a する verb ({危惧|きぐ}する — to fear, to be apprehensive about). Most commonly encountered in the compound {絶滅|ぜつめつ}{危惧|きぐ}{種|しゅ} (endangered species).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{危惧|きぐ}される — to be a cause for concern
・{危惧|きぐ}の{念|ねん} — feelings of apprehension
・{絶滅|ぜつめつ}{危惧|きぐ}{種|しゅ} — endangered species
・{危惧|きぐ}を{抱|いだ}く — to harbor concerns

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{懸念|けねん} — concern, misgivings (also formal)
・{心配|しんぱい} — worry (everyday, more casual)
・{不安|ふあん} — anxiety, unease
